caption: This drawing, rendered in shades of black and gray pencil on a cream-colored paper, depicts a detailed study of an ornate pitcher or jug. The central part of the composition features the main view of the pitcher, which has a wide spout, a curved handle with elaborate scrollwork, and a footed base with beaded ornamentation. The body of the pitcher is decorated with raised floral and leaf motifs. Encircling the main drawing are three inset panels: the upper left inset shows an oval cartouche with foliage, scrolling borders, the monogram "AFG" and the year "1766"; the lower left inset shows a side profile of the pitcher with annotated measurements (4 1/2" tall, 4" wide, and base 2 1/2" wide); and the lower right inset shows a close-up sketch of the pitcher’s handle from the back, adorned with additional floral and scroll decorations. The artist’s name, Michael Fengler, is written in the lower right quadrant below the central image. All linework is done in graphite, and the drawings use shading to suggest the three-dimensional form of the objects.
title: Silver Creamer
